bot_short_description: Leave now. Rejoin later — private invitations or public links.
bot_description: A privacy-first Telegram group return scheduler. Privately choose a group and a return time. RejoinLaterBot will use a private invitation when it has the required group access, or a public group link when that is the available option.
command_about: How the bot works and privacy
command_add: Schedule a return to a group
welcome:
RejoinLaterBot helps you step away from Telegram groups and return later.

Use /add and privately choose a group. RejoinLaterBot will check whether it can create a private return invitation. If not, it will offer a public group link when the group is public. Then choose a return time and leave the group yourself.
managed_setup:
Managed Return setup:
1. Add RejoinLaterBot to the group.
2. Make it an administrator.
3. Enable only Invite Users (called Invite Users via Link in some Telegram clients).

No other administrator permissions are needed.
privacy:
RejoinLaterBot never stores group names, descriptions, avatars, message history, or your Telegram username, first name, or last name.

For public-group reminders, the group's public Telegram address is temporarily stored in encrypted form. It is required so RejoinLaterBot can open the same public group when your timer ends.
blocked_info: Removing this conversation does not cancel scheduled returns. If you block the bot, Telegram may prevent return messages from being delivered. Your scheduled return remains pending. After you unblock RejoinLaterBot and start it again, overdue returns will be processed.

scheduled_managed:
Your return by private invitation is scheduled.

You can now leave this group yourself.

If needed, you can clear the message history and delete this chat with the bot without blocking it.

☝️ If you are still a member of the group at the scheduled return time, the private invitation will not be sent.
scheduled_public:
Your return by public group link is scheduled.

You can now leave this group yourself.

If needed, you can clear the message history and delete this chat with the bot without blocking it.
permissions_missing: This is a private group, so RejoinLaterBot also cannot provide a public link for you to rejoin on your own. Ask a group administrator to add RejoinLaterBot, make it an administrator, and grant the Invite Users permission. Then run /add again.
